name: Arion banki hf.
summary: Arion banki hf. provides various financial services to individuals, corporates, and investors in Iceland and internationally. The company operates through three segments: Retail Banking, Corporate and Investment Banking, and Markets and Stefnir. The Retail Banking segment offers financial services, which include deposits and loans, savings, payment cards, pensions, insurance, securities, and funds. Its Corporate & Investment Banking segment provides a range of products, such as guarantees, deposit accounts, payment solutions, and value-added digital solutions to SMEs, large-cap companies, and investors; and various financial advisory services, including M&A advisory, private placements, IPOs…
